origin.note: The commit the origin https://getunstuck.space is expected to serve. Written by the deployer at the end of every successful preview, so it always names the PREVIOUS deployment's commit — a repo cannot contain the sha of the commit that writes it. Read by tests/site_stamp.test.mjs (L61/L62): the live page must name the commit this pin names, and depth_from_head must equal git rev-list --count <expected_commit>..HEAD. Deploying also refreshes it, so a deploy is never blocked by a pin the deploy just wrote.
